stylePrompt:
Build رحلتنا as an Arabic-first shared pregnancy journey with a cinematic baby hero leading a quiet, practical companion. The hero owns the emotional emphasis: protected text and an oversized gestational number sit around the image focal area, then the interface becomes a warm reading surface of appointments, preparation tasks and family planning. Arabic headings are mature and open, with isolated tabular numerals for dates, weeks and amounts. The app is a narrow mobile column even on wide screens. Rounded cards and pill actions feel soft, but hierarchy is firm: one principal action, compact metadata, generous section rhythm and occasional asymmetric bento groupings. Use subdued colour to identify care, preparation, attention and current-stage status; keep long text and most surfaces neutral. Finance feels private and matter-of-fact, not like a trading dashboard.

Dark surfaces should evoke a quiet room at night, with restrained translucent navigation and sheets over media. Motion is a short press response, a gentle sheet rise and a controlled hero expansion; respect reduced motion and retain a still poster. Dense rows belong to checklists and settings, while welcome, birth and baby views can breathe. Avoid neon, space imagery, toy-like type, emoji icons, decorative gradients behind every card, and arbitrary colourful dashboards. V2 reference images guide photographic mood and composition, but are impressions, not evidence that features, imagery or personal sample data already ship. The code extraction remains the authority for exact shipped values and states; record defects rather than disguising them as new design choices.

rules.statement: Source: hamza00555-sketch/Rehlatna, commit 34d1c09. Extracted from src/design/tokens.ts, generated tokens.css, globals.css and all CSS modules. Captures record the live demo; V2 mockups remain impressions.
Use semantic colour roles. Exact duplicate paints are consolidated; onPrimary maps to surface and focus maps to medical. No hue-number palette.

Pregnancy uses warm current-stage accents, medical context uses medical surfaces, completion uses readiness/success, finance progress uses funding, and errors use danger. Pair status colour with text or an icon.

Canonical completeBorder consolidates owned/completed near-duplicate borders; attentionBorder consolidates needed/attention near-duplicate borders. Previews preserve legacy shipped values. Existing callers must be migrated explicitly; do not claim the repository was rewritten.
Seven spacing steps only. Layout-specific geometry is not extra spacing scale: page gutter 20px, grid gap 12px, section rhythm 24px, max column 520px, four grid columns.
RTL narrow single mobile column; main bottom navigation has four destinations, fixed with safe-area padding. Page reserves 82px plus section spacing and safe-area bottom.
IBM Plex Sans Arabic for UI; Inter for numeric runs with tabular figures and bidi isolation. Arabic-formatted dates keep RTL; numeric-only runs use LTR. No playful display fonts.
Shipped fast/base/slow durations are 160ms/260ms/420ms using cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0.24, 1). Reduced motion becomes 120ms opacity only and static posters. No autonomous ornamental motion.
Primary button min-height 52px; standard controls 50px; icon buttons 44px. Chips 34px and switches 32px keep extended 44px pointer targets through pseudo-elements.
Theme aliases control reading surfaces and text. Fixed light semantic cards intentionally reset ink/muted to light values in both themes. Do not invert images or blindly swap every light paint.

BabyHero is edge-to-edge in its column, lower corners rounded, min-height 430px with height clamp(430px,60vh,560px). Place text outside the image focal area and keep scrims. Expanded hero is fixed fullscreen with a close affordance.
Media uses cover plus a deliberate focal point; weekly poster is the reduced-motion fallback. Missing media is a real neutral placeholder, not an invented image.
Bottom sheets use native dialog semantics, a dim backdrop, top rounded corners, bounded height and scrolling. Keep safe areas and escape/close paths.
No custom :hover selectors ship. Hover previews therefore equal default. Do not invent bright hover colours when extracting. Focus remains visibly outlined.
Use the shipped bespoke SVG line icons, not emoji. Directional chevrons follow RTL; status marks pair with text.
Finance is not embedded in shared preparation data; financial actions appear only for authorized viewers. Styling a lock is not access control.
Primary pill for the main action; outline/quiet for secondary choices; danger for destructive confirmation; lightOverMedia for cinematic screens.

V2 images are approved mood/composition references. Their sample names, dates, hospitals and medical numbers are not authoritative production data. Some file titles mismatch content; describe actual images.

Undefined --radius-pill in SignIn and --text-sm in AppointmentForm are defects, not approved tokens. Browser ignores these declarations; previews retain the actual fallback. IconButton neutral border-color receives a border shorthand and is ignored.
